# ADR-0008: Leave the terminal gate untouched and prove earlier announcement with a sink-capturing conformance test

**Status:** Accepted
**Context:** VerificationGoalGate.onGoalCompletionAttested (verification-goal-gate.ts:302-351) is the fail-closed terminal check and must keep failing runs with any unowned invariant. There is no event journal, so a conformance test cannot replay a real run; the injectable sink from ADR-002 is the only capturable record.
**Decision:** Do NOT edit packages/baro-orchestrator/src/verification/verification-goal-gate.ts in this run — no message change, no new field read.
Tests (node:test, `test/<area>/<name>.test.ts` per adr/0013):
- packages/baro-orchestrator/test/planning/invariant-coverage-report.test.ts — unownedInvariantIds incl. fail-as-full-gap, formatInvariantIdList 40-cap, invariantGapSummary, renderUnownedInvariantLines.
- packages/baro-orchestrator/test/planning/planner-progressive-invariant-note.test.ts — publisher receipt carries `invariantNote` + `unownedInvariantIds`, absent when the gap is empty; stderr line asserted by the same `process.stderr.write` patch style as test/planner-progressive-obligation-note.test.ts:106-121; warn captured through `onInvariantCoverageGap`.
- packages/baro-orchestrator/test/planning/goal-invariant-canonicalization.test.ts — drift canonicalized + one note; unknown id, compound claim and intra-story duplicate all hard-rejected; idempotence on already-canonical text.
- packages/baro-orchestrator/test/planning/planner-prompts-repair.test.ts (extend) — new section text and ordering; byte-identity when `unownedInvariants` is undefined vs absent.
- packages/baro-orchestrator/test/planning/invariant-coverage-conformance.test.ts — the required conformance test: admit a fragment whose stories claim none of the invariants through the publisher with a capturing sink, then build the terminal attestation for the same contract, assert the gate still fails (`success:false`, message contains `global goal is not satisfied`), and assert the captured announcements are non-empty and that every id in `openInvariantIds ∪ rejectedInvariantIds` appeared in at least one earlier announcement (receipt `unownedInvariantIds` and/or sink warn). Assert at-least-once, never exactly-once.
Verification commands: `node --import tsx --test packages/baro-orchestrator/test/planning/<file>.test.ts` per file, plus `npm run -w packages/baro-orchestrator typecheck` for any story touching types. Never run `npm test -w packages/baro-orchestrator`. There is no lint script — do not invent one. Commit/PR body must contain `Fixes #112`. Keep comments lean per CLAUDE.md.
**Consequences:** Terminal semantics are provably unchanged because the file is not edited. The conformance guarantee is enforced through the sink rather than a journal; if a future lane bypasses the publisher and the coordinator, the guarantee would need re-proving there.
